subject: general
question: The elections for Panchayat are conducted by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**State election commission.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **State election commission:**

 
 
• It is a **constitutional body.**
 
• The Indian Constitution establishes the State Election Commission **to oversee state elections for panchayats and municipalities.**
 
• According to **Article 243K(1)**, a State Election Commission made up of a **State Election Commissioner who will be chosen by the Governor** will have **superintendence, direction, and control over the creation of electoral rolls for all elections to Panchayats (Municipalities under Article 243ZA) **as well as their conduct.
 
• Article 243K(2) specifies that the legislation passed by the state legislature will govern the State Election Commissioner's tenure and condition of the service.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Election commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• It is an** independent constitutional body** responsible for conducting free and fair elections in the country.
 
• It was established in **1950.**
 
• It is empowered under **Article 324** of the Indian Constitution **to oversee, direct, and manage elections for the parliament, state legislatures, the office of the president of India, and the office of the vice president of India.**
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and any additional election commissioners, if any, that the President may from time to time designate, will make up the Election Commission.
 
• It is **currently comprised of two Election Commissioners and the CEC.**
 
• They hold office for a set period of time, which is either six years or until they turn 65.
 
• They may be removed prior to the end of their term or resign at any moment.
 
• Parliament must carry out a removal procedure similar to that of a Supreme Court judge in order to remove the CEC from office.
 
 
 
• **Revenue Department** **of the state:**
 
 
• It is responsible for the assessment, collection, and management of revenue in the state.
 
• It also deals with** land records and settlement.**
 
 
 
• **Urban local government** :
 
 
• The **74th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 established the constitutional framework for the system of municipalities, sometimes known as urban local governments.**
 
• This amendment's provisions are contained in Part IXA, which went into effect on June 1st, 1993.
 
• **"The Municipalities" is the title of Part IXA, which includes Articles 243-P through 243-ZG. **
 
• The act also amended the Constitution by adding a new **Twelfth Schedule.** There are** eighteen operational municipal items** in this schedule. 
 
• It is responsible for the administration of urban areas, including the provision of **basic amenities, infrastructure development**, and maintenance of **law and order.**
 
• Depending on their size and territory, the Act allows for the formation of **three different kinds of municipalities** in each state. 
 
 
• Municipal Corporation for a bigger urban area 
 
• Municipal Council for a smaller urban region
 
• Nagar Panchayat for an area that is transitioning from a rural to an urban environment.
